company.name: Bank AlBilad
company.shortDescription: Bank AlBilad provides solutions in multiple segments including retail banking, business products, investment, and international remittance.
company.description:
Bank AlBilad strives for excellence in the Islamic banking sector through the introduction of initiatives, innovation, and genuine shariah-compliant banking products to meet and transcend the aspirations of the customers, employees, and shareholders. It provides solutions in multiple segments including retail banking, business products, investment, and international remittance.

The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Riyadh.
